Issue: Category and sort URLs share the shop title and canonical
Recommended Fix: Keep one shop document. Do not give each filter its own title while the canonical stays /en/shop.

Issue: Translated legal pages can be indexable while the sitemap lists English URLs only
Recommended Fix: Confirm whether approved translations should be indexed. If they should the sitemap must include them. If they should not the page robots must stay noindex.

Issue: Search Console coverage and sitemap status are unchecked
Recommended Fix: Open Indexing Pages and Sitemaps and record the result. Do not infer index counts from the repository.

Issue: Generative AI inclusion and the Generative AI performance report are unchecked
Recommended Fix: Open the Search Console setting and report. Code eligibility does not mean the pages are shown.
